title: Enterprise Azure Lakehouse
description: Production-style Azure data engineering pipeline that ingests transactional data from Azure SQL into ADLS Gen2 and processes it through a Databricks Medallion architecture with full DQ validation, schema drift handling, and CI/CD automation.
situation: Needed a scalable, production-grade lakehouse pipeline demonstrating end-to-end Azure data engineering skills for an enterprise context.
task: Design and implement a full Medallion architecture (Bronze → Silver → Gold) with metadata-driven ADF ingestion, incremental watermark extraction, Unity Catalog, and automated deployment via GitHub Actions.
action: Built Terraform-managed Azure infrastructure, ADF metadata-driven pipelines with watermark-based incremental loads, Databricks notebooks for Bronze/Silver/Gold processing with DQ gates and quarantine, schema drift detection, SCD Type 2 customer dimension, and Databricks Asset Bundle CI/CD.
result: Deployed a fully automated lakehouse with 7 Unity Catalog schemas, star schema Gold layer, audit logging, quarantine support, and dual CI/CD workflows — demonstrating enterprise data engineering patterns from ingestion to reporting.
